title: Hearty Egyptian Shrimp Stew
description: A traditional Egyptian dish featuring dried shrimp in a rich and flavorful stew, slow-cooked to perfection in a lotus leaf wrap, this recipe is gluten-free friendly and serves as a hearty dinner option.
instructions: Rehydrate the dried shrimp by soaking them in water overnight, then drain and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the rehydrated shrimp to the pot and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the stew for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Prepare the lotus leaves by washing and drying them, then cutting them into large squares.
Spoon the shrimp stew onto the center of each lotus leaf square, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the lotus leaves over the stew to form a tight package, securing with toothpicks if necessary.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
